title: Artemis I Orion First Imagery of Earth
description: Seen here is the Orion capsule first look back at Earth for the Artemis I mission. The Space Launch System rocket and the Orion spacecraft launched at 1:47am EST from Kennedy Space Center launch pad 39B. This will be an uncrewed flight test that will demonstrate the ability of the SLS rocket to safely carry the Orion spacecraft around the Moon and its return and recovery to Earth for the agency’s Artemis Program.
